title: RBT — Business Metrics
description: Queue depth, conversion, expiry and missed turns per event. Values are read from PostgreSQL/Valkey at scrape time; panels aggregate with max because every instance reports the same rows.

list.name: event_id
list.label: Event

query.query: query_result(((max by (event_id) (rbt_queue_waiting_count)) * on (event_id) group_left (event_name) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info)) or label_replace((max by (event_id) (rbt_queue_waiting_count)) unless on (event_id) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info), "event_name", "$1", "event_id", "(.*)"))

list.definition: query_result(((max by (event_id) (rbt_queue_waiting_count)) * on (event_id) group_left (event_name) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info)) or label_replace((max by (event_id) (rbt_queue_waiting_count)) unless on (event_id) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info), "event_name", "$1", "event_id", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Waiting in queue

targets.expr: ((max by (event_id) (rbt_queue_waiting_count{event_id=~"$event_id"})) * on (event_id) group_left (event_name) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info)) or label_replace((max by (event_id) (rbt_queue_waiting_count{event_id=~"$event_id"})) unless on (event_id) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info), "event_name", "$1", "event_id", "(.*)")

panels.description: Live WAITING entries per event (read from Valkey).

panels.title: Active slots

targets.expr: ((max by (event_id) (rbt_queue_active_count{event_id=~"$event_id"})) * on (event_id) group_left (event_name) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info)) or label_replace((max by (event_id) (rbt_queue_active_count{event_id=~"$event_id"})) unless on (event_id) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info), "event_name", "$1", "event_id", "(.*)")

panels.description: Slots in use: ADMITTED, CLAIMED and MISSED not yet swept. A flat line at capacity means the queue moves at the configured rate.

panels.title: Conversion (%) = paid bookings / admissions

targets.expr: ((max by (event_id) (rbt_booking_conversion_percent{event_id=~"$event_id"})) * on (event_id) group_left (event_name) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info)) or label_replace((max by (event_id) (rbt_booking_conversion_percent{event_id=~"$event_id"})) unless on (event_id) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info), "event_name", "$1", "event_id", "(.*)")

panels.description: Of the buyers who reached the detail page (admission), the share that paid.

panels.title: Booking expiry (%)

targets.expr: ((max by (event_id) (rbt_booking_expired_percent{event_id=~"$event_id"})) * on (event_id) group_left (event_name) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info)) or label_replace((max by (event_id) (rbt_booking_expired_percent{event_id=~"$event_id"})) unless on (event_id) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info), "event_name", "$1", "event_id", "(.*)")

panels.description: Bookings that ran out of payment time, as a share of all bookings.

panels.title: Missed turn (%) = unclaimed admissions / admissions

targets.expr: ((max by (event_id) (rbt_booking_missed_turn_percent{event_id=~"$event_id"})) * on (event_id) group_left (event_name) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info)) or label_replace((max by (event_id) (rbt_booking_missed_turn_percent{event_id=~"$event_id"})) unless on (event_id) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info), "event_name", "$1", "event_id", "(.*)")

panels.description: Turns that were never claimed before the claim window closed.

panels.title: New admissions per minute

targets.expr: ((delta((sum by (event_id) (max by (event_id, status, reason) (rbt_booking_admissions{event_id=~"$event_id"})))[5m:30s]) / 5) * on (event_id) group_left (event_name) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info)) or label_replace((delta((sum by (event_id) (max by (event_id, status, reason) (rbt_booking_admissions{event_id=~"$event_id"})))[5m:30s]) / 5) unless on (event_id) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info), "event_name", "$1", "event_id", "(.*)")

panels.description: Average over the last 5 minutes: buyers entering the detail page.

targets.expr: ((max by (event_id, status) (rbt_booking_bookings{event_id=~"$event_id"})) * on (event_id) group_left (event_name) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info)) or label_replace((max by (event_id, status) (rbt_booking_bookings{event_id=~"$event_id"})) unless on (event_id) max by (event_id, event_name) (rbt_booking_event_info), "event_name", "$1", "event_id", "(.*)")
